units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣劝诫髭黑大将道：“此事若教皇上得知，你该何等惶恐。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, admonished General Higekuro, saying, "If His Majesty were to learn of this, how terribly ashamed and fearful you would have to be.

units.source_text: 我看暂勿走漏消息为是。”

en.t: I think it would be best not to let the news leak out for the time being."

units.source_text: 然而髭黑大将得意忘形，毫不顾虑。

en.t: Yet General Higekuro was so elated that he lost all restraint and gave no thought to caution.

units.source_text: 玉鬘虽已和他同居多时，但对他绝不开诚相爱。

en.t: Although Tamakazura had already lived with him for some time, she never opened her heart to him or loved him sincerely.

units.source_text: 她自叹这是意想不到的宿世孽缘，一直愁眉不展。

en.t: She lamented to herself that this was an unexpected ill-fated bond from a former life, and she remained downcast.
General Higekuro could hardly bear the pain of it.

units.source_text: 但念好事既成，因缘非浅，则又不胜欣喜。

en.t: But when he thought that the affair had already succeeded and that their bond was not shallow, he was overcome with joy again.

units.source_text: 他觉得此人越看越是可爱，真乃合乎理想的娇妻。

en.t: The more he looked at her, the more lovable she seemed to him; she was truly the charming wife of his dreams.

units.source_text: 险些儿被别人占夺了去。

en.t: She had almost been seized and taken away by someone else.

units.source_text: 这样一想，竟心惊肉跳起来，便想把替他穿针引线的侍女弁君和石山寺的观世音菩萨并列起来，向她们顶礼膜拜。

en.t: When he thought of that, he was so shaken that he wanted to place the maid Ben no Kimi, who had acted as his go-between, alongside the Bodhisattva Kannon of Ishiyama Temple and bow down before them both.

units.source_text: 然而玉鬘恨煞了弁君，此后一直疏远她，使她不敢前来伺候，只得日夜笼闭在自己房里。

en.t: Yet Tamakazura bitterly hated Ben no Kimi and kept her at a distance thereafter, so that the maid no longer dared come to serve her and could only shut herself up in her own room day and night.

units.source_text: 为了玉鬘而刻骨相思、备尝失恋之苦的人，不知凡几。

en.t: There was no telling how many men had loved Tamakazura with a longing that cut to the bone and had tasted the bitterness of unrequited love.

units.source_text: 而石山寺的观世音菩萨偏偏保佑了这个她所不爱的髭黑大将。

en.t: And yet the Bodhisattva Kannon of Ishiyama Temple had chosen to bless this very General Higekuro, whom she did not love.

units.source_text: 源氏也不喜此人，深感惋惜。

en.t: Genji, too, did not like the man and felt deeply sorry about the matter.

units.source_text: 然而他想：“事已如此，夫复何言。

en.t: Still, he thought, "Since things have come to this, what more is there to say?

units.source_text: 况且内大臣等都已许诺，我若出来反对，表示不满，则对不起髭黑大将，在我亦属多事。”

en.t: Besides, the Minister of the Interior and the others have already given their consent; if I were to step forward in opposition and show displeasure, it would be unfair to General Higekuro and would only be meddlesome of me."

units.source_text: 就安排盛大仪式，竭诚招待这位新女婿。

en.t: He therefore arranged a grand ceremony and received this new son-in-law with wholehearted hospitality.
